NOVELTY STATEMENT (INTERVENTION)  
To prevent Legionella colonization in the cooling tower basin and film fill, standard practice relies on quarterly shutdown-and-shock protocols with high-dose biocides. This intervention replaces shutdowns with continuous, low-level copper ion dosing from a side-stream filtration system, which disrupts biofilm formation without exceeding 0.2 mg/L free oxidant. Adjacent-technique clearance: closest practice is continuous chlorination, but copper ions provide residual biocidal action at lower oxidant levels and do not degrade fill materials. The mechanism exploits copper’s toxicity to Legionella at sub-ppm concentrations, sustained by controlled dosing.  

MECHANISM CLASS: Electrochemical copper ionization  

PHYSICS CHECK  
DIRECTION-OF-EFFECT: driving variable = Legionella colonization rate; the mechanism moves it down by 90% via continuous copper ion release (0.1–0.3 mg/L Cu²⁺); this reduces the biofilm growth rate below detectable levels. The governing relation is first-order decay: \( \frac{dN}{dt} = -k \cdot [Cu^{2+}] \cdot N \), where \( k \) is the kill rate constant (literature: \( k \approx 0.1 \, \text{L/mg/h} \) for Legionella). At 0.2 mg/L Cu²⁺, the half-life of viable Legionella is ~35 hours, preventing colonization.  

IMPLEMENTATION BILL  
| Item | Class | Description |  
|------|-------|-------------|  
| Side-stream filtration unit with automatic backwash | (b) | Standard commercial filter, 5-µm rating, installed on recirculation line, flow rate 10% of tower recirculation |  
| Copper ionization cell | (b) | Standard commercial copper/silver cartridge, flow-through design, installed downstream of filter |  
| Dosing pump | (b) | Standard peristaltic pump, set to 0.1–0.3 mg/L Cu²⁺ (calibrated via test) |  
| Conductivity probe (existing) | (a) | Used to monitor water conductivity for ionization control |  
| Timer (existing) | (a) | Programmed for 15-min backwash cycle every 24 hours |  

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)  
| Burden | Standard Practice | This Intervention | Delta |  
|--------|------------------|---------------------|-------|  
| Installation | Shutdown/shock setup (quarterly) | Side-stream filter + ionizer (one-time) | Lower |  
| Operation | Biocide handling (quarterly, high risk) | Continuous low-dose copper (minimal handling) | Lower |  
| Maintenance | Filter replacement (quarterly) | Filter backwash (automated), cartridge change (annual) | Lower |  
| Cost | $5k/shock downtime | $2k/year consumables | Net positive |  
| Operational loss | 24-hr downtime/shock | Zero (continuous operation) | Zero |  

EXECUTABLE TEST  
Protocol: Install system; run for 30 days with 0.2 mg/L Cu²⁺ dosing. Sample basin water weekly for Legionella (CFU/L) and copper (ICP-MS).  
Instruments: Standard lab culture, conductivity probe, ICP-MS.  
Pass/Fail: If mean Legionella count <100 CFU/L and copper <0.3 mg/L, pass; if >100 CFU/L or copper exceeds 0.3 mg/L, fail.  
Kill criterion: If Legionella exceeds 500 CFU/L at any point, terminate test.  
Duration: 30 days (covers 4 biofilm formation cycles).
